moves.label: Quick Baton Swipe
moves.description: Fast high baton swipe with a tiny active window and clean recovery.
moves.reason: Short standing baton arc hits high and returns to guard.

moves.label: Low Patrol Sweep
moves.description: Instant low sweep with huge active baton pressure across the floor.
moves.reason: Long baton sequence is authored low and visually sweeps forward.

moves.label: Police Body Jab
moves.description: Quick mid body jab with a brief active hit and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Compact punch posture hits through the torso line.

moves.label: Heavy Patrol Kick
moves.description: Slow mid kick with a long active leg swing and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Standing kick arc rises through the body line.

moves.label: Sliding Baton Hook
moves.description: Steady mid sliding hook with a modest active swing and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Ryotsu drops into a seated slide and hooks forward with the baton.

moves.label: Kankichi Coin Flourish
moves.description: Slow mid ki flourish with long active prop pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Visual shows a comic held prop/ki action and the move already uses ki without launch height.

moves.label: Baton Step Combo
moves.description: Fast mid baton combo with long active pressure and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Ryotsu chains several baton poses at body height.

moves.label: Low Comic Feint
moves.description: Slow low feint with a long active tumble and measured recovery.
moves.reason: The animation dips and tumbles low before resetting.

moves.label: Low Flip Launcher
moves.description: Slow low launcher with a long active flip that pops opponents up.
moves.reason: Low flip kick carries authored launch height.

moves.label: Patrol Cartwheel Knockdown
moves.description: Quick mid jumping knockdown with a modest active flip and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Cartwheel-like jump attack is authored as knockdown.

moves.label: Grounded Panic Rush
moves.description: Instant mid grounded rush with long active sliding pressure and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Full-crouch sequence crawls/slides forward through several active frames.

moves.label: Crouch Police Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid crouch launcher with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch-to-rise posture matches the authored launcher height.

moves.label: Overdrive Baton Swipe
moves.description: Quick high overdrive baton swipe with a modest active arc.
moves.reason: Overdrive route reuses the high baton swipe frames.

moves.label: Kankichi Aura Drive
moves.description: Quick special knockdown drive with huge active baton-aura pressure.
moves.reason: Long aura-backed baton sequence is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: Overdrive Flip Tornado
moves.description: Instant mid jumping flip that works as a tornado extender.
moves.reason: Overdrive flip leaves the ground and is authored as tornado.

moves.label: Sidestep Flip Tornado
moves.description: Instant mid sidestep flip that works as a tornado extender.
moves.reason: Sidestep variant uses the same airborne tornado flip.

moves.label: Rising Police Jab
moves.description: Quick mid while-rising jab with a long active shove and quick finish.
moves.reason: While-standing route uses the mid body-jab family.

moves.label: Rising Flip Tornado
moves.description: Steady mid jumping tornado flip with a tiny active hit and high recovery.
moves.reason: While-standing kick enters the airborne tornado flip.

moves.label: Ducking Baton Swipe
moves.description: Quick high ducking baton swipe with a modest active arc.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the quick high baton swipe.

moves.label: Diagonal Police Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid diagonal launcher with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Down-forward command carries authored launcher height.

moves.label: Patrol Rushdown
moves.description: Fast mid rushdown with huge active running pressure and almost no recovery.
moves.reason: Long forward-running sequence hits at body height.

moves.label: Forward Police Jab
moves.description: Quick mid forward jab with a long active shove and quick finish.
moves.reason: Forward-heavy command matches the mid body-jab animation.

moves.label: Baton Quick Swipe
moves.description: Quick high quarter-circle baton swipe with a modest active arc.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab repeats the high baton swipe frames.

moves.label: Police Flip Tornado
moves.description: Slow mid jumping tornado flip that knocks down after a tiny active hit.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle flip is authored as tornado, jump, and knockdown.
